Definition
[Covariant derivative of a vector field]

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0294 1. Section A.2\group first-order-differential-operators-on-tensors

In a local coordinate chart, the covariant derivative of a vector field $X$ has components \[ abla _i X^k = rac{\partial }{\partial x^i}X^k + \Gamma ^k_{ij}X^j, \] and one customarily writes $ abla _{\partial /\partial x^i}$ as $ abla _i$.
